role: Secondary structural-mechanism confirmation only. Does not alter or rescue the frozen WFTS primary replication classification.

naamp_prediction_source.interpretation: Historical-template coupling is stronger in deep k>=4 activation than shallow k=1-3 after exact k and fixed q are conditioned.

population.base: Exactly the WFTS primary-confirmatory eligible matched comparisons after the frozen structural and strictly-prior-history gates.
population.taxon_cluster: Taxa acoustically silent at all ten stations in the drier focal run.
population.history: Only same route x SurveyPeriod runs before the earlier focal year with >=8/10 focal physical-site overlap, identical to the primary prior-history eligibility rule.
population.eligible_cluster: Observed wet k>=1, at least one focal SiteID with strictly-prior CI>=2 and at least one focal SiteID without strictly-prior CI>=2.

q_source.definition: Fixed q from the prospective 3-complete-day Daymet common-environment comparator, with strictly-prior site history, a=0.75 drier-state persistence, route-cross-fitted species environment response and pair-level total-incidence matching.

exact_k_alignment.k: Observed number of wet calling-positive stations for the focal taxon.
exact_k_alignment.prior_strong: Focal physical SiteID at which that taxon reached call_index>=2 in at least one eligible strictly-prior run.
exact_k_alignment.observed_overlap: Number of wet active stations that are prior-strong.
exact_k_alignment.conditional_null: Condition exactly on observed k. Among all choose(10,k) station subsets, probability is proportional to the product of fixed q/(1-q) odds for included stations.
exact_k_alignment.overlap_excess: Observed overlap minus its exact q-conditioned expectation.

primary_test.endpoint: Matched-design rainfall coefficient difference beta_deep(k>=4) - beta_shallow(k=1-3) for summed q-conditioned overlap excess within each focal pair.
primary_test.support_rule: Observed deep-minus-shallow coefficient exceeds the simulated upper 95% bound and plus-one P<0.05.

secondary_test.endpoint: Deep k>=4 rainfall coefficient for q-conditioned overlap excess.
secondary_test.support_rule: Observed coefficient exceeds its simulated upper 95% bound and plus-one P<0.05.

decision.template_link_support: Informativeness gate passes and both primary deep-minus-shallow contrast and secondary deep-only alignment pass.
decision.template_link_non_support: Informativeness gate passes but one or both fixed support rules fail.

interpretation.support: Prospective external support that deep species-night activation is preferentially expressed through a recurrent strong-site template rather than a uniform whole-route switch.
interpretation.boundary: Does not identify individual fidelity, hydrological causation, social attraction, movement or a unique lower-level mechanism.

anti_tuning: Do not change k>=4 threshold, CI>=2 prior-strong definition, q source, exact-k conditioning, pair design, informativeness gate, simulation count, seed or tail after WFTS outcomes are opened.
Do not promote 1-day or 7-day weather sensitivities to the q source for this test.
